brand_voice_note: Precision-driven and performance-obsessed, blending Olympic-grade clarity claims with a quiet eco-conviction and rugged, terrain-ready confidence.

concepts.primary_text:
See what you've been missing.

The Sawtooth XL takes you from alpine airstrips to downtown streets without missing a beat. FUTR LenZ technology is engineered to eliminate distortion and deliver maximum optical clarity, so the world reads true wherever you are.

Ultralight, plant-based construction. Clarity for the driven.
concepts.headline: Clarity That Moves With You
concepts.why_it_works: The oldest direct-response move in eyewear: show the glare, then show it gone. The buyer understands the ZEISS lens in under a second with no copy needed, which is what a cold feed placement demands.
concepts.visual_direction: Single continuous high-glare alpine scene. Everything outside the lenses is blown out and hazy; everything seen through them is saturated and razor sharp. The difference lands exactly at the lens rim.

concepts.primary_text:
Snow, dirt, rain. One shield handles it all.

The Peak bridges the gap between sunglasses and goggles with a 5.2-base cylindrical ZEISS lens for all-conditions clarity. SCREENZ 360 ventilation actively pulls air through the frame to reduce fogging, keeping the lens crystal clear even during extreme exertion.

Go-anywhere. Do-everything.
concepts.headline: Clear In Every Condition
concepts.why_it_works: At a $299 price point the buyer needs justification, not atmosphere. Stacking the ZEISS lens, plant-based frame, steel flex hinge and lifetime warranty in one frame answers the price objection inside the creative, before the click.
concepts.visual_direction: Clean hero on a dark seamless background with deliberate empty margin on all four sides. Those empty zones are where the callout labels and leader lines get composited on top.

concepts.angle_label: Origin Story - Zero Mold, Zero Waste
concepts.primary_text:
Heritage, reimagined for the modern adventurer.

Co-founded by U.S. Olympian Justin Reiter, the Peak Pioneer carries classic glacier-glass DNA into next-gen performance. The bio-based Zirtek frame is made with plant-based material using 3D Selective Laser Sintering, paired with ZEISS optics for all-terrain clarity.

Alpine ridges to city streets. Athlete-proven, built with conviction.
concepts.headline: Glacier DNA, Rebuilt
concepts.why_it_works: Nobody else in eyewear can run this ad. Showing the frame coming out of a powder bed makes the 3D-printed, zero-waste, plant-based story physical instead of a bullet point, and it reframes the price as craft rather than markup.
concepts.visual_direction: The frame half-emerged from fine white nylon powder on a printer build plate, powder still clinging to it. Manufacturing proof as the hero, product as the reveal.
